Kim / Alex — looked into the event metadata. The organizer is "Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finify.com>" and the event was created by Finify's side. When an external organizer creates the event, GSuite sometimes strips our internal Meet/Zoom provider metadata for guests depending on ACLs. That explains the blank Join field.

What I suggest:
1) We create a new event from demo@redwood.com and invite Finify as attendees (keeps host control).
2) We'll include both the canonical Zoom link and the Meet fallback in the body.
3) Send the new invite and ask Finify to accept; acceptance should populate the Join UI for their users.

I attached a repaired .ics (demo-slot-ics.ics) that sets demo@redwood.com as the organizer. If you're okay, Kim, I can issue the new invite from demo@redwood.com and mark Ben as host in Zoom so the recording/host privileges persist.
